Package hadur117.sepia

Class InkWave

java.lang.Object
hadur117.sepia.InkWave
public final class InkWave extends Object
One enemy shot, read from its energy drop, with the landing Sepia has fixed for it.

The geometry is the kernel's Wave: source, fire tick, speed and the precise intersection that gives the hit set. Sepia adds what the ink needs: the hit set of the committed landing (lo to hi, bearings from the source), the tick the wave can first meet the body there (arrival) and the tick it has passed (passed), and the shadows our bullets in the air cast on it before arrival (INK-5).
